propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC mutation route must have exactly one typed coordinator/adapter owner with no generic fallback dispatch.
Generic whole-operation retry, _best_effort write swallowing, class-name duck typing, and duplicate SDK/adapter retry must be unreachable from production code.
Unsupported production mutation actions must fail with a typed provider-neutral error before any local or remote effect occurs.
Production dispatch must use explicit @runtime_checkable declared protocols (e.g., MutationShape) rather than class-name strings or isinstance checks across reloaded module boundaries.
Tests must use explicit declared protocol fakes instead of production fallback paths to avoid masking routing errors.
Rollback must be implemented as code/routing reversion plus remote re-observation, never by remote deletion of successful work.
